title: Cases routes
description: The routes of decision 0020 slices S1, S3 and S3b (docs/reference/cases/README.md, docs/reports.md): the stored cases (what was sent), one case built now or read back, the person's "Send to gcx", the daily usage records and the Dashboard's mark. Additions to /api/v1.

row.description: One stored case as "What was sent" lists it, never its body. state: waiting (to be sent), sent at sentAt, held (the last check found an address at error's path; never sent), refused (by our server, error its text). sending (S3, absent on a case only the person's press sends): collecting (still open, its trigger may join it), queued (gcx sends it by itself), off (closed while automatic sending was off), skipped (past the backlog's bound); off and skipped go on the person's Send. more: occurrences of the same trigger past the day's 20 cases, kept here.

list.description: GET /api/v1/cases: every stored case, newest first.

view.description: GET /api/v1/cases/{id}: the case (an order's, a bot's or the runtime's built now and written nothing; a stored one as it was stored) and, with ?timeline=<language>, its timeline.

usage.description: GET /api/v1/usage (S3b, d16): the install reference that stands for this gcx in every report and record, and each daily record built, newest first: its state (waiting, sent at sentAt, held: the last check found an address at error's path, refused: our server's text in error) and the record or heartbeat as it goes (pulse.schema.json).

usageMark.description: POST /api/v1/usage/dashboard (S3b, d16.1): the Dashboard was opened. Any field is ignored: the runtime marks its own current UTC day.

sendBody.description: POST /api/v1/cases/{id}/send: the person's own line (500 characters), kept as written after the free-text pass.

sent.description: The answer to a send: the stored case's id and its state (sent; waiting when our server did not answer, Send again later; held with the path where an address was found; refused with our server's text).
